description: Treasure Hunter's Assistant dialogue at the temple for Crystal Ascendancy quest

dialogue_lines._comment: ========== FIRST VISIT: Player arrives at temple ==========

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: You made it! Long trek eh?

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: That temple is messy business, you may want to set your spawn somewhere in case you end up sleeping with the fishes. Hehe.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: Came all this way and didn't bring a pokemon to help you enter the temple? Eh, to each their own. Good luck I guess!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: Thanks to your pokemon breathing should be much easier in there. Try not to die in there!

dialogue_lines._comment: ========== RETURN VISIT: Player comes back (no tablet yet) ==========
========== PLAYER HAS TABLET: First time celebration ==========

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: You actually did it! I had no faith in you at all!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: It's time for you to return home. Bring this tablet to the Treasure Hunter in his studies.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: Lovely, you brought a pokemon with Teleport with you. They'll help you get home in a jiffy!

actions.hover_text: Click to teleport back to the Spawn

dialogue_lines.speaker: Treasure Hunter's Assistant
dialogue_lines.text: It's a long journey back. Good luck, trainer!
